brief: A caddy for next to my kitchen sink: a dispenser that pours out bleach for wiping the counters, plus two bins for sponges.

requirements.evidence: Two full cells piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full joined with side-connector, each holding bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain and bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain (drained bins suit wet sponges next to sink). check_build clear.
requirements.requirement: Caddy for next to kitchen sink

requirements.evidence: Two drained bins built (see above). No sponge props exist in catalog (find_props sponge/clean/soap/dish returned none), so bins left empty for user's own sponges.

No pouring/dispensing part exists in catalog (port family is plug/louvre/screen/barb/gland only; bin spout/funnel/soap/bottle searches empty) and configurator checks fit only with no knowledge of materials, chemical compatibility, waterproofing or bleach safety. Parts are 3D-printed in user-chosen material. A 3D-printed bleach-pouring dispenser cannot be verified safe, so nothing built for bleach.
requirements.requirement: Dispenser that pours out bleach for wiping counters

finish.summary: Built 2-cell caddy with two drained bins for sponges. Did not build bleach dispenser: no dispensing/pouring part exists and bleach chemical safety/material compatibility is outside what the configurator can verify - keep bleach in its original container.

lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

parts.name: Port plug
parts.use: Blanks a side port you are not using, so a cell that is closed up looks finished and nothing gets in through a hole you left open.

parts.name: Port louvre
parts.use: Vents a closed cell without letting rain in, so a box that has to breathe can still stand outside.

parts.name: Port screen
parts.use: Passes air and keeps insects and debris out, so a cell can breathe through an opening that is still covered.

parts.name: Port hose barb
parts.use: Lands a hose on a cell, so water arrives and leaves through a spigot drawn for it rather than over an edge.

parts.name: Port cable plate
parts.use: Leads cable through a side port on finished holes, so wiring enters a closed cell through something drawn for it and each run has its own way in.
